question: SAI is the apex national sports body of India. What is the full form of SAI?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sports Authority of India.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **SAI stands for Sports Authority of India.**
 
• It is the **apex national sports body of India, responsible for the development and promotion of sports in the country.**
 
• SAI was established in **1984 under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• It has multiple regional centers and training facilities across the country to support athletes and promote sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sports Authority of India (SAI) is a registered society set up by the Govt. of India in Jan. 1984.
 
• Govt. of India established the Sports Authority of India for promotion of sports, exploration of sports talent at young age and nutrition, organization of sports competitions, providing facilities, utilizing stadiums, and maintaining them in appropriate conditions.
 
• The Sports Authority of India is the Sports Body of India under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It was established in 1984.
 
• Its headquarters is in New Delhi.
 
• Hon'ble Prime Minister of India is now the Ex-officio President of SAI.
